results.releaseNotes:
Version 1.5 is the biggest update yet - a whole new way to see your blood oxygen over time!

TRENDS ON THE MAIN SCREEN
The chart at the top has been rebuilt. Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days, and see each day's full range along with its average. O₂ Buddy remembers whichever range you used last.

NEW: DAY VS NIGHT
Tap the moon to compare your daytime readings against your overnight ones. If you wear your watch to sleep, try this one first.

RICHER READING DETAILS
Tap any reading to see where it fell that day, how it compares to readings taken around the same time on other days, and whether it's normal, below normal, or low.

NEW TREND WIDGET
A new Home Screen widget shows your 7-day trend at a glance, in small and medium sizes.

NEW WATCH COMPLICATIONS
• A color-coded gauge ring for circular slots
• A 7-day trend sparkline for rectangular slots
• Older readings now dim, so you always know when you're looking at stale data

FASTER, MORE RELIABLE SYNC
New readings reach your watch and complications faster, and complication updates now keep working reliably all day long.

A FRESH LOOK
Onboarding has been redesigned, and you can now set the app to Light, Dark, or Automatic in Settings.

Plus a tip jar for anyone who'd like to support development - entirely optional, and it unlocks nothing.

Thanks for using O₂ Buddy!
results.description:
O₂ Buddy makes your blood oxygen readings effortless to see, understand, and track - on your iPhone, your Home Screen, and your wrist.

Your Apple Watch already measures your blood oxygen throughout the day and night. O₂ Buddy turns those readings into something you can actually use.

SEE YOUR TRENDS
• Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days with a tap
• Every day shows its full range alongside its average, so you see the whole picture - not just the last number
• Watch your average rise or fall compared to the period before

DAY VS NIGHT
• Compare your daytime readings against your overnight ones, side by side
• Wear your watch to sleep and see how your oxygen behaves while you rest

EVERY READING IN CONTEXT
• Tap any reading to see where it falls within that day
• Compare it against readings taken around the same time on other days
• Know instantly whether it's normal, below normal, or low

ON YOUR WRIST
• A fast, glanceable Apple Watch app with your recent readings and 7-day trend
• Complications in circular, rectangular, corner, and inline styles - including a color-coded gauge ring and a 7-day trend sparkline
• Readings sync from your iPhone as soon as they're recorded

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• A widget for your latest reading
• A widget for your 7-day trend

LOW OXYGEN ALERTS
• Optional notifications when a reading falls below a threshold you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Read-only access to Apple Health
• Your data stays on your devices - never uploaded, never shared, never sold

Also includes Light, Dark, and Automatic appearance, 12- or 24-hour time, and built-in FAQs and support.

O₂ Buddy is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose or treat any condition. Blood oxygen measurements are recorded by Apple Watch and stored in the Health app.
